_comment: Gemini CLI command configuration template. Drop into .gemini/gemini_cli_config.json. Each entry under 'commands' is a named shell shortcut.

<command_slug>.description: <One-line description shown in Gemini's command picker.>

_field_reference.command: Required. Shell command string. For multi-step operations, call a small script instead of embedding a long pipeline.
_field_reference.description: Required. One concise line for the command picker.
_field_reference.directory: Optional. Working directory relative to the repo root. Omit for repo root.

_anti_patterns: Do not put secrets in command strings.
Do not use commands for interactive workflows.
Do not shadow built-in commands without a clear reason.
